messages.subject: Multisession maks in multisession OpenCR
parts:
Hello everyone,

I have a dataset that I'm analysing on spatial and non spatial OpenCr. The data consists of inter-annual data between 2015 and 2020, hence i've created a multisession object were each year is a primary session. The main parameter I want to calculate is time specific density. Since distance between movements and detections vary within years, the mask is different for each year.  

When i run the multisession object the program realises that there are different masks and just defaults to the first one, instead of using the yearly specific mask for each of the yearly calculations. I'm unsure of how to get around this, do i just need to separate the object into single sessions per year? although this would provide estimates between months instead a whole value for the year itself. 

Any insights on the above would greatly appreciated.

Cheers,

Diana

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Multisession maks in multisession OpenCR
parts:
Diana
" Since distance between movements and detections vary within years, the mask is different for each year." ? I don't think you make a case, and this cannot be done in 'openCR'. The primary sessions are merged ('joined') into a single-session object for analysis, and the code does not allow a time-varying mask extent. Just go with a mask that is generous enough for the primary session with the largest movement, with a larger buffer if you think there is between-session movement of centres. Of course the mask is not relevant for nonspatial models.
Murray
